exposure: 18 different MRI parameters of placenta accreta spectrum
MRI parameters of placenta accreta spectrum
cohort: 64 pregnant women with suspected placental invasion based on clinical history of cesarean delivery, ultrasound findings, or both
finding: Eight MRI parameters, including bulge, placenta previa, low-attenuation T2 linear bands, placental heterogeneity near the scar, and fibrin deposition, were statistically significant predictors of placental invasion and correlated with the need for cesarean hysterectomy and pathologic/surgical impressions of invasion.
